newsitem.title: USA: Mavesa to sell baby food business.
newsitem.headline: Mavesa to sell baby food business.

text.p: Mavesa SA said Monday it has agreed to sell its Yukery baby food business to Novartis Nutrition de Venezuela SA, a unit of Novartis AG.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

Mavesa said that it will retain the use of the Yukery name for food products other than those marketed to infants, and will continue to manufacture Yukery baby food for Novartis under contract during a transition period.
The company said that the deal has been approved by Venezuelan regulatory officials and is expected to close later this summer, subject to due diligence and customary contract completion procedures.
